complete_examples.text: Train-track-bridge interaction (TTBI) describes the dynamic behavior of trains passing over bridges [1,2].

Firstly, to construct the simu lation framework, the finite element and multi-body methods are used to model the dynamic behavior of a train-track-bridge interaction (TTBI) system and a pier-cap-pile-soil interaction system.
